deck_structure: Treat packages 6939 and 6957 as one integrated player operation and one briefing deck.

packages.briefing_read: Strategic air-defense suppression and forward fighter screen. Low SA-10 missile supply is a general feature of the target set: Alpha and Bravo are assessed RED, while North is assessed BLACK. Plasma 3 destroys mobile SA-10 Alpha and Bravo; Hawkeye 6 destroys coastal SA-10 North; Devil 1, Eagle 5, and Lancer 7 protect the attacks and then press toward Pohang when the relevant SAM gate is open.

sad_contracts.contract: Find and destroy SA-10 Alpha and Bravo
sad_contracts.intent: Hook south of Killbox 3 and use the mountainous terrain for a masked ingress if either SA-10 becomes active. Push north, locate and destroy both Flap Lid radars, then destroy the battalions in place with CBU and GBU-54. Alpha and Bravo are mobile, currently undeployed, and their missile supply is assessed RED. They are not expected to be an immediate medium-altitude package threat unless they deploy or radiate. Execute at the briefed TOT.

Find and destroy SA-10 North, the coastal site threatening Killbox 1 and constraining attacks on Alpha and Bravo. Its missile supply is assessed BLACK; plan the primary attack from altitude, which should provide a reliable attack solution against the site. Continue to respect any observed radiation or launches. Confirm the site neutralized so the eastern fighter screen can press toward Pohang.

cap_contracts.contract: Western safe patrol, then forward patrol and Pohang sweep
cap_contracts.sector: Safe patrol STPT 3-4; forward patrol STPT 5-6; southwest-to-northeast Pohang axis
cap_contracts.intent: Establish the western safe patrol at STPT 3-4, outside SA-10 North's WEZ. If Alpha or Bravo is active, remain west and provide standoff cover until Plasma 3 confirms its tasking complete. Move to the desired forward patrol at STPT 5-6 only after SA-10 North is confirmed down and Alpha/Bravo are no longer factor. If SA-10 North remains active, stay at STPT 3-4 for the duration. Once the forward gate is open, press Pohang southwest-to-northeast and intercept bandits departing the airfield.

cap_contracts.contract: First-arriving western safe patrol, then forward patrol and Pohang sweep
cap_contracts.sector: Safe patrol STPT 3-4 near Dongsong-ri; forward patrol STPT 5-6; west-to-east Pohang axis
cap_contracts.intent: Arrive at the western screen at 1814Z, one minute before Plasma 3's 1815Z DEAD time. Establish the safe patrol at STPT 3-4, outside SA-10 North's WEZ. If Alpha or Bravo is active, stand off west and cover Plasma 3 until it confirms the sites are no longer factor. Move to the desired forward patrol at STPT 5-6 only after SA-10 North is confirmed down and Alpha/Bravo are no longer factor. If SA-10 North remains active, stay at STPT 3-4. Once the forward gate is open, push west-to-east onto Pohang and intercept bandits departing the airfield.

cap_contracts.contract: Safe northeast block, then forward northeast patrol
cap_contracts.sector: Safe patrol STPT 3-4; forward patrol STPT 5-6; north-northeast threat axis
cap_contracts.intent: Establish the safe patrol at STPT 3-4, outside SA-10 North's WEZ, and support Hawkeye 6 from standoff while blocking the north-northeast approach. If Alpha or Bravo is active, remain west of the factor threats until Plasma 3 completes its tasking. Move to the desired forward patrol at STPT 5-6 only after SA-10 North is confirmed down and Alpha/Bravo are no longer factor. If SA-10 North remains active, stay at STPT 3-4. Intercept naval aviation and other bandits arriving from the north-northeast.

packages.fallback_logic: The Eagle screen defaults to the safe western patrol geometry at STPT 3-4. If Alpha or Bravo is active, the Eagles remain west until Plasma 3 confirms its DEAD tasking complete. STPT 5-6 are the desired forward patrol points but lie inside SA-10 North's threat area; the Eagles may use them only after SA-10 North is confirmed down and Alpha/Bravo are no longer factor. If SA-10 North never goes down, all three Eagle flights remain at STPT 3-4 and do not press Pohang.

packages.briefing_read: Killbox interdiction package. The three relevant SA-10 battalions are generally missile-depleted—Alpha and Bravo are assessed RED, while North is assessed BLACK—but remain factor threats until confirmed neutralized. Spade 7 holds local TARCAP over the killboxes while four AI flights attack enemy maneuver forces on the western/forward edges of Killboxes 1-3. AI execution is independent of the Alpha/Bravo SEAD result; if those SA-10s are active, use low-altitude pop-up attacks with standoff PGMs rather than waiting.

cap_contracts.intent: Protect the AI flights over the killboxes and intercept bandits entering the killbox area. Secondary priorities are protecting friendly troops from fixed-wing attack and supporting defensive Eagle flights, but remain on station and do not abandon the killbox screen.

strike_contracts.intent: Attack the forward edge of enemy troops maneuvering toward friendly forces. This is a priority sector because a breakthrough is possible.
Attack enemy forces preparing to move south or northwest to outflank and attack friendly forces.
Arrive roughly three minutes after Mudhen 7, receive a target-area lowdown, and continue working the same sector for maximum effect.
Attack the leading edge of enemy troops. Expect a high SHORAD threat, including SA-19 near Steer 6 and SA-13s in the area.

packages.fallback_logic: All AI flights attack regardless of the Alpha/Bravo status. If Alpha or Bravo is active and factor, execute low-altitude pop-up attacks with standoff PGMs; do not hold or wait for the SA-10s to be destroyed.

commander_intent: Protect friendly forces and break the enemy maneuver on the Daegu front while stripping the remaining strategic SAM cover and denying Pohang as a fighter source. Low missile supply is a general theme across the SA-10 target set: Alpha and Bravo are assessed RED, while North is assessed BLACK. Package 6939 exploits that depletion to suppress the mobile/coastal SA-10s—Hawkeye 6 can reliably attack SA-10 North from altitude—while Package 6957 maintains continuous killbox interdiction under a dedicated local TARCAP.

package_flow_contracts.geometry: Devil 1, Eagle 5, and Lancer 7 establish their safe patrols at STPT 3-4, outside SA-10 North's WEZ.
package_flow_contracts.gate: Default geometry on arrival. Eagle 5 reaches the screen at 1814Z, one minute before Plasma 3's 1815Z DEAD time.

package_flow_contracts.geometry: If SA-10 Alpha or Bravo is active, all three Eagle flights stand off to the west and cover Plasma 3 from the safe patrol.
package_flow_contracts.gate: Remain west until Plasma 3 confirms Alpha and Bravo are no longer factor.

package_flow_contracts.geometry: STPT 5-6 are the desired forward patrol points for Devil 1, Eagle 5, and Lancer 7, but they are inside SA-10 North's threat area.
package_flow_contracts.gate: Advance from STPT 3-4 to STPT 5-6 only after SA-10 North is confirmed down and Alpha/Bravo are no longer factor. If SA-10 North survives, remain at STPT 3-4 for the mission.

deconfliction: Plasma 3 works south of Killbox 3, then north onto SA-10 Alpha and Bravo; its masked route must remain clear of the Killbox 3 AI flow.
Hawkeye 6 and Lancer 7 work the eastern/coastal SA-10 North problem.

Devil 1, Eagle 5, and Lancer 7 initially use safe patrol STPT 3-4 outside SA-10 North's WEZ. If Alpha/Bravo are active, they stand off west until Plasma 3 completes its tasking. They advance to desired patrol STPT 5-6 only after SA-10 North is down and Alpha/Bravo are no longer factor; otherwise they remain at STPT 3-4.
After the forward-patrol gate opens, Devil 1 and Eagle 5 may press Pohang on their briefed axes while Lancer 7 maintains the north-northeast block.
Spade 7 remains over the killboxes and does not chase threats away from its primary station area.
Mudhen 7 and Cyborg 5 sequence onto the same Killbox 1 sector; Cyborg 5 checks in for Mudhen 7's target-area lowdown.
All AI flights continue their attacks regardless of Alpha/Bravo status and use low-altitude pop-up/standoff profiles if either site becomes factor.
